variants.additional_context: Optimize only cpp/external/lambdatwist/p3p.cc. The source shown to you is the current best accepted version for this closed-loop experiment, not necessarily the original baseline. Prefer one small, local, low-risk C++ performance improvement per iteration. Preserve numerical behavior, solver API, output semantics, includes, benchmark compatibility, root-selection logic, degeneracy handling, and Eigen aliasing safety. Do not change tests, benchmark code, adapters, CMake files, configs, docs, or orchestrator code. Use line_range_edits only for cpp/external/lambdatwist/p3p.cc. The original field in each edit must exactly match the numbered source lines without line-number prefixes. If no safe new improvement is available, return a no-op candidate with expected_effect="none" and edits=[].
